general_information.Description: This course is organized into three part: - "Basic Concepts" offers a survey on mobile and wireless networks and the major security basics - "Discovering" ;ooks at the issue of security of current mobile and wireless networks, namely Wi-Fi, WiMAX, Bluetooth and GSM/UMTS, and concludes with a description of the mechanisms for the protection of downloaded applications in the context of mobile operators. - "Emerging Technologies" focuses on the security of new communication technologies, namely the new generation of telecommunication networks such as mobile IP networks, and self-organized ad hoc and sensor networks.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Kali linux, Wifi TP-Link, bluetooth devices, (optional) RFID Reader and Tag, RF module.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the principles of wireless and mobile communications systems: propagation, cellular concept, channel coding, multiple radio access and multiple division techniques.
Understand current typical wireless communications networks: mobile communications systems, satelite systems, Ad Hoc and sensor networks, WMAN, WLANs, WPANs, Bluetooth, Zigbee, RFID.
Understand the various technologies with a focus on vulnerabilities and security solutions and the related security of the current mobile and wireless technologies.
Analyze and Evaluating Wireless and Mobile Network Security
Skill of presentation and working in group
